adjudication.rationale: In `TopicEmbed.import`, the URL is only gated by `return unless url =~ /^https?\:\/\//`, which merely checks the prefix and would allow quotes/angle brackets in the remainder of the string. The code then interpolates `url` directly into an HTML snippet: `"#{url}"` and appends it to `contents`. Imported posts are created with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`, and `Post#cook` returns `raw` for that cook method, so no sanitization/rendering pipeline runs. Finally, the embed view renders `raw post.cooked`, making this a verifiable XSS/injection path introduced by the diff.
